scope: Package 2 Step T. Define load/fault scenarios and evidence collection only. Do not execute load, chaos, fault-injection, database, provider or E2E tests until all four package implementations are complete.

safetyBoundary.allowedEnvironment: isolated local TEST only, after explicit final-phase test approval
stopConditions: Any unexpected non-loopback database or provider target is detected
Financial or booking invariants are violated
Test requests escape the approved local TEST boundary
Resource exhaustion threatens the developer machine or unrelated process
A dependency outage causes uncontrolled retry amplification

fieldsToApprove: concurrent virtual users and request arrival model
mix of read, write, booking, payment-sandbox and realtime operations
test runner/resource ceiling and stop thresholds
p50/p95/p99 latency targets by critical endpoint family
per-endpoint error-rate ceiling and saturation behavior

scenarios.injection: Drive the approved request mix at the approved concurrency and arrival profile.
scenarios.expectedSafeBehavior: Latency/error/resource measurements are captured; rejected/limited requests use documented responses; no cross-user data exposure or duplicate protected action.

scenarios.injection: Use an isolated local TEST database proxy or controlled local database pause to introduce latency and connection failure.
scenarios.expectedSafeBehavior: Requests fail or degrade within approved limits; transactions do not partially commit; health/readiness reflects dependency state; the process does not leak credentials or SQL details.

scenarios.injection: Use mocked/local provider adapters or sandbox endpoints to simulate timeout, 429, 5xx and connection reset.
scenarios.expectedSafeBehavior: Retries remain bounded; ambiguous payment/delivery outcomes remain UNKNOWN or reconcilable; no duplicate charge, payout, OTP or delivery is inferred from timeout alone.

scenarios.injection: Disconnect and restore the client network during login, booking mutation, trip completion, admin save and realtime streaming.
scenarios.expectedSafeBehavior: Clients show pending/unknown outcomes as appropriate, reconcile against Backend truth after reconnect, and do not blindly repeat non-idempotent writes.

scenarios.injection: Use a controlled local client that reads slowly, disconnects, resumes with Last-Event-ID and sends malformed/expired cursors.
scenarios.expectedSafeBehavior: Memory remains bounded; unauthorized events are not delivered; replay-gap behavior is explicit; reconnect refreshes authoritative state; malformed frames do not advance the cursor.

scenarios.injection: Enqueue a bounded approved fixture burst and include deterministic invalid payloads, retryable provider failures and exhausted-attempt jobs.
scenarios.expectedSafeBehavior: Claim/lease ownership is enforced; retries are bounded; invalid/exhausted work is retained in a terminal state; ACK/idempotency prevents duplicate logical delivery; backlog is observable.

scenarios.injection: Restart only isolated local TEST processes at controlled points before claim, after claim, after provider submit and before durable ACK.
scenarios.expectedSafeBehavior: Durable queued work can be reconciled after restart; expired leases can be reclaimed safely; ambiguous external outcomes are not treated as confirmed success; credentials remain protected.

scenarios.injection: Submit concurrent same-key and distinct-key booking/payment/refund fixture operations using approved idempotency keys.
scenarios.expectedSafeBehavior: Uniqueness and transaction invariants hold; no duplicate booking, charge, refund or ledger entry; conflicting outcomes are explicit and auditable.

scenarios.injection: On an isolated local TEST database, create bounded competing transactions against approved fixture records and observe lock/wait behavior.
scenarios.expectedSafeBehavior: Deadlocks/timeouts are surfaced as safe retriable or terminal errors; transaction rollback preserves invariants; retry policy avoids an unbounded retry storm.

scenarios.injection: Run a bounded local TEST profile near the approved CPU/memory/connection/backlog ceiling with explicit auto-stop thresholds.
scenarios.expectedSafeBehavior: Health and error signals remain available; process avoids uncontrolled memory growth; rate/queue limits operate; recovery after load returns to baseline within approved target.

approvalsRequiredBeforeExecution: all test targets verified to be local TEST or approved sandbox
test data fixtures and cleanup/retention rule approved
monitoring/metrics capture and emergency stop operator assigned
finalPhysicalTests: Execute LF-001 to LF-010 only after all four package implementations are complete and workload/SLO decisions are approved.
Capture raw metrics and redacted logs with testRunId/buildRevision/environmentId; never include tokens, OTPs, secret values, private keys or personal records.
Check financial, booking, ownership and delivery invariants before and after each fault.
Record scenario result PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED with evidence; do not infer PASS from service restart alone.
knownGaps: No quantitative workload profile is approved.
No p50/p95/p99, error-rate, availability or resource-ceiling SLO targets are approved.
